title: Circles, Areas and Combined Solids
summary: Grade 10: tangents to circles, areas of sectors and segments, and surface areas and volumes of combined solids.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Breaking complex shapes into simple ones lets designers calculate the materials and space they need.

factual: Why is a tangent perpendicular to the radius?
How do you find the area of a segment?
conceptual: Why does melting and recasting keep volume but change surface area?
debatable: Should packaging be designed to use the least material, even if it looks less attractive?
